name: Actor removes one product and keeps the others
scenarioId: classpath:features/cart:Actor removes one product and keeps the others
methodName: Actor removes one product and keeps the others

testSteps.description: Given Actor is on the home page
When Actor adds "Combination Pliers" to the cart
And the cart badge should show "1"
And Actor adds "Pliers" to the cart
And the cart badge should show "2"
And Actor is on the cart page
And Actor removes "Combination Pliers" from the cart

Then the cart should contain the following products:
| Product | Price |
| Pliers | $12.01 |

userStory.narrative:
As a customer,
  I want to manage products in my shopping cart
  So that I can review and adjust my order before checkout

title: Actor removes one product and keeps the others

rule.name: Customer should be able to remove products from the cart
